description: Implementation of hashtablez sampler functions for profiling and debugging hash tables in the Abseil library.

classes.name: HashtablezInfo
classes.description: Holds profiling information for a hash table instance, including statistics and timestamps.

methods.name: HashtablezInfo::PrepareForSampling
methods.description: Initializes profiling data for sampling, setting counters and capturing stack trace.

methods.name: SampleSlow
methods.description: Determines whether to sample a hash table operation based on sampling rate and configuration.

methods.name: UnsampleSlow
methods.description: Unregisters a hash table info from sampling.

methods.name: RecordRehashSlow
methods.description: Records a rehash event and updates total probe length.

methods.name: RecordReservationSlow
methods.description: Records a reservation of capacity in the hash table.

methods.name: RecordStorageChangedSlow
methods.description: Updates size and capacity info after storage changes.

methods.name: RecordInsertSlow
methods.description: Records an insertion, updating hash and probe length statistics.

methods.name: RecordEraseSlow
methods.description: Records an erase operation, updating size and erase count.

methods.name: SetHashtablezConfigListener
methods.description: Sets a callback for configuration changes.

methods.name: SetHashtablezSampleParameter
methods.description: Sets the sampling rate for profiling.

methods.name: GetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Returns maximum number of samples to keep.

methods.name: SetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Sets maximum number of samples to keep.
